goal: Close the owner-authorized VII operational gaps with one verified test booking, a protected supplier conversion report, observed scheduler and Aurora status, verified CMS paths and an executable availability matrix.

intent_model.literal_request: Perform section 1 on Roy's place under Adir's name, treat Max's conversions endpoint as ready, explain and complete sections 3 to 5, defer legal and domain work, record media approval, and build section 9's matrix.
intent_model.implied_outcome: Adir should receive working operational features and exact evidence instead of another list of plans or unexplained blockers.
likely_rejections: A booking was not actually verified.
The report exposes private contact data.
Scheduler or Aurora status is inferred from code only.
A deployment drops existing v570 behavior.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Implement and verify safe in-scope work without returning routine engineering tasks to Adir.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Each section needs a concrete result or a genuinely human-only blocker.

interpretation_rules.phrase: על המקום של רועי והשם שלי
interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Use only the verified designated test place and Adir Naor's verified contact identity.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: No invented venue or identity and no payment or duplicate submission.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: The operator selects an existing business and sees trusted local funnel metrics plus verified supplier conversions.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Choose business and date range, then inspect aggregate source and order outcomes.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Use the evidence to follow up with the business or investigate a failing source.
deferred_complexity: raw customer contact rows unless explicitly required

natural_destination: https://vii.spaplus.co and its authenticated /admin/business-performance and /admin/catalog-sync routes.

facts.claim: The public v570 read path identifies Aurora as its data origin.
The supplier documents server-only conversions for vacations, events and rooms.
The worker source schedules capability refresh every tick and discovery warmers every 30 minutes.

assumptions.claim: Roy's designated supplier place can be identified from current supplier truth without publishing the internal fixture.
assumptions.validation: Read provider catalog and exact venue details through the authenticated server path before booking.

assumptions.claim: The production admin session can expose scheduler and CMS readback without changing data.
assumptions.validation: Open authenticated admin routes and inspect persisted timestamps and role behavior.

invariants: supplier token and customer PII never reach public browser code
booking write is attempted at most once
undated capability never claims dated availability
Hebrew uses the approved modern sans-serif stack

requirements.statement: Create at most one non-payment supplier test booking for Roy's verified place under Adir Naor's verified identity and read it back by partner reference.
Show supplier conversion aggregates for an authorized selected business and range without exposing tokens or raw customer PII to the browser.
requirements.source: Current user instruction and supplier docs

requirements.statement: Verify the production refresh scheduler and persisted cache/catalog timestamps rather than treating source code as runtime proof.
Separate and verify Aurora public reads, writes, transactions and recovery evidence without destructive tests or inflated claims.
requirements.source: Current user clarification and master plan

requirements.statement: Verify CMS authentication, role scope, loading, empty, error, save persistence and natural-destination reflection for the changed admin family.
requirements.source: Current user clarification and product standard

requirements.statement: Persist the owner's attestation that reused media comes from the prior owned site while preserving per-asset provenance requirements.
Provide and execute a durable risk-based availability matrix covering worlds, dates, geography, party, filters, cache and supplier failure.
Publish only one frozen passing candidate and verify the exact live version with rollback identity.

acceptance_checks.setup: Verified Roy site, available non-payment stay, verified contact fields and one reserved partnerRef
acceptance_checks.action: Read partnerRef, submit once only if absent, then read it back
acceptance_checks.observable_result: One confirmed or pending-approval booking identifier matches site, room, dates, price, guest and partnerRef; no payment and no second POST.

acceptance_checks.action: Do not repeat POST; query the same partnerRef
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Original status is resolved by readback or remains explicitly unknown without a duplicate booking.
Unauthorized returns 403; authorized server route returns validated aggregate summary only and client receives neither token nor contact rows.

acceptance_checks.setup: Invalid range, unsupported place or provider failure
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The UI shows a precise recoverable state and preserves the prior selection without invented zeros.

acceptance_checks.setup: Deployed scheduled worker and production database
acceptance_checks.action: Read scheduler dashboard and cache/catalog state across reload
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Recent persisted timestamps and statuses survive reload, or the exact unobserved process remains not verified.

acceptance_checks.action: Exercise safe read, isolated rollback-safe write/readback and transaction probes where an existing health path permits
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Each dimension has exact evidence; destructive failover and backup restoration remain separately classified if not exercised.
Interface remains usable, protected and consistent; any actual saved CMS change is verified in its natural destination.
Project evidence identifies prior owned site as approved source without claiming unknown individual releases.

acceptance_checks.setup: Executable matrix against frozen public release
acceptance_checks.action: Run all P0 and P1 cases
acceptance_checks.observable_result: World, URL, cache, dated availability, nearby fallback and supplier-failure contracts either pass or block release with exact case IDs.

acceptance_checks.setup: Passing frozen commit and previous live version
acceptance_checks.action: Save, deploy and verify the exact production artifact
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Deployment succeeds, live version/commit match, post-deploy checks pass and rollback version remains identified.

open_questions.question: Does the existing authenticated environment expose Roy's verified site and Adir's required contact fields for the test booking?
open_questions.resolution: Inspect approved supplier/catalog sources and private contact store before any write; if a required human-only field is absent, only REQ-1 remains blocked.

authorization_boundary: Safe implementation, testing, one idempotent non-payment test booking and publication are authorized. No payment, DNS, destructive database/failover action, credential rotation or legal compliance claim.
